title: CAD Design Challenge
details: Flagship Aerospace CAD Modeling & Generative Design Challenge hosted by Dr. Satish Dhawan Aerospace Engineering Association (DSDAEA) at PSG College of Technology. Cadets engineer 3D parametric models of supersonic aerodynamic airfoils, UAV fuselages, rocket nozzle contours, and structural aerospace assemblies. Showcase your 3D design acumen and precision engineering.
prizes: Design Excellence Trophies, Cash Awards & Official Merit Certifications
rounds: Round 1: Rapid 3D Component Modeling | Round 2: Aerodynamic Assembly & Rendering

title: Horizon Cup: Olympiad & Quiz
details: Premier Aerospace Olympiad and Quiz competition organized by DSDAEA. Two high-stakes competitive rounds testing conceptual aerospace acumen across aerodynamics, orbital mechanics, astronomy, space exploration history, rocketry, and satellite systems. Challenge your peers and prove your flight science expertise.
prizes: Merit Trophies, Cash Awards & Official Certifications
rounds: Round 1: Wednesday (Oct 14) - 04:30 PM to 06:00 PM | Round 2: Thursday (Oct 15) - Finals

title: Flight & Propulsion Systems
details: Flagship Technical Workshop on Flight & Propulsion Systems hosted by Dr. Satish Dhawan Aerospace Engineering Association (DSDAEA) at PSG College of Technology. In-depth masterclass exploring the Principles of Flight (Lift, Weight, Thrust, Drag) and Aerospace Propulsion Evolution from early Rotary Piston Engines and Turboprops to Turbojets, Ramjets, and Mach 5+ Scramjets.
prizes: Official DSDAEA Technical Certification & Aero Kit
tagline: Four Forces • One Balance • Sustained Flight
rounds: Session 1: Aerodynamics & 4 Flight Forces | Session 2: Jet Propulsion & Scramjets
